note_ko: 장소 디테일 기준(docs/장소팩_작성기준.md)에 따라 작성(2026-10-25 추가). {s}/{S}=she/She, {p}/{P}=her/Her, {o}=her, {lit}=빛이 닿는 의상 부분.
setting_en: a narrow alley lined with small shops and lit neon signs
feature_en: pink and teal neon tube signs mounted on the shop walls
closed metal shop shutters in dark gray and brick red
ground_en: small puddles between patched gray concrete
far_en: the alley running away between two rows of small shops
a few round white lamps hanging far down the alley

밤.sky_en: a black night sky above the narrow roofline
밤.light_en: pink neon light comes from the camera's left and teal neon light comes from the camera's right, both falling on {p} hair, face and shoulders
밤.shadow_en: the far end of the alley and the spaces between the signs fall into deep shadow behind {o}
밤.desc_ko: 맑은 밤, 분홍 네온이 카메라 왼쪽, 청록 네온이 오른쪽에서 비춤

비 온 뒤 밤.time_en: a night just after the rain
비 온 뒤 밤.sky_en: a dark night sky with a few thin clouds
비 온 뒤 밤.light_en: pink neon light comes from the camera's left and a warm white lamp hangs above and in front of {o}, falling on {p} face and shoulders
비 온 뒤 밤.shadow_en: the far end of the alley falls into deep shadow behind {o}, with long streaks of pink and white lying on the wet lane toward the camera's right
비 온 뒤 밤.desc_ko: 비 온 뒤 밤, 분홍 네온과 위쪽 흰 등이 비추고 젖은 길에 색이 길게 번짐

초저녁.sky_en: a deep blue sky above the narrow roofline

초저녁.desc_ko: 초저녁, 막 켜진 분홍 네온이 카메라 왼쪽에서, 푸른 저녁빛이 위 뒤에서 비춤

주머니에 손 넣고 서기.pose_en: stands in the middle of the lane with one hand in a pocket and the other holding a bag strap
주머니에 손 넣고 서기.moment_en: {s} looks toward the camera with a playful smile
주머니에 손 넣고 서기.desc_ko: 한 손은 주머니에, 한 손은 가방끈을 쥐고 카메라를 보며 웃음

벽에 기대기.pose_en: leans one shoulder against a shop wall with {p} arms crossed loosely
벽에 기대기.moment_en: {s} looks toward the camera with a calm smile

돌아보며 걷기.pose_en: walks away down the lane and turns {p} head back over one shoulder

네온 올려다보기.pose_en: stands in the lane with {p} chin lifted toward a neon sign above
네온 올려다보기.moment_en: {s} looks up at the neon sign with a faint smile
네온 올려다보기.desc_ko: 골목에서 위의 네온 간판을 올려다보며 미소

눈 감고 미소 짓기.pose_en: stands in the neon-lit lane with {p} eyes closed and {p} face turned slightly upward
눈 감고 미소 짓기.desc_ko: 네온 골목에서 눈을 감고 얼굴을 살짝 들어 입을 다문 채 미소

입가 가리고 웃기.desc_ko: 네온 골목에서 손등으로 입가를 가볍게 가리고 눈웃음으로 카메라를 봄

camera.허리 위: Medium shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to {p} waist, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the neon signs softly out of focus
camera.허벅지 위: Medium shot from eye level with a 50mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to mid-thigh, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the neon signs softly out of focus
camera.3/4 전신: Three-quarter shot from eye level with a 40mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to just below the knees, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the neon signs softly out of focus
camera.가슴 위: Close portrait from eye level with a 70mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to mid-chest, vertical frame, shallow depth of field with the neon signs softly out of focus
camera.클로즈업: Close-up portrait from eye level with an 85mm lens, the frame running from the top of {p} head to {p} collarbones with {p} face filling about two thirds of the frame height, square frame, shallow depth of field with the neon signs softly out of focus
